method: Supplied initial 48-actor arena, followed by production GameSession.step, FixedClock, MotionInterpolation, Controller/TouchControls and native Phaser Renderer on its real frame loop. Not natural gameplay; not the complete C2 game.js entry or complete HUD; not phone hardware.
setup: 2 slime mages + 2 builders + 2 static nests + 4 fastlings + 38 basic viruses = 48. No FISSION. Wave 2, one ordinary finite future slot at 3600 seconds, empty same-wave territory/smart-support tasks. No spawning/hatching plans. Player starts at normal 100 HP. No shooting, dash, garrison, HP refill, actor replacement or state edits after initialization.
measurement: Four sequential 15-second wall-time groups in one Chrome context; real keyboard on desktop and trusted CDP touch through production TouchControls at touch resolution. Each rendered frame and each fixed simulation step must retain exactly 48 live/reserved actors, playing phase and wave 2. Per-frame production diagnostics add observer overhead. No recording or forced GC during sampling.

groups.inputScope: Trusted keyboard events through production Controller; not full desktop HUD.
